name: NATCO Pharma Limited
summary: NATCO Pharma Limited, a pharmaceutical company, engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and marketing of finished dosage formulations, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and intermediates in India, the United States, and internationally. It operates through two segments: Pharmaceuticals and Agrochemicals. The company offers formulations in various therapeutic areas, including cancers of blood, liver, kidney, lung, brain, breast, and ovary; and APIs in various categories, such as oncology, central nervous system, pain management, and cardiovascular care.
